crossRefs.note: “Yes, the light of the wicked will be put out. The spark of his fire won’t shine.
The light will be dark in his tent. His lamp above him will be put out.
He will be driven from light into darkness, and chased out of the world.
The light of the righteous shines brightly, but the lamp of the wicked is snuffed out.
Whoever curses his father or his mother, his lamp shall be put out in blackness of darkness.
for there will be no reward to the evil man. The lamp of the wicked will be snuffed out.
The foolish said to the wise, ‘Give us some of your oil, for our lamps are going out.’
Many sorrows come to the wicked, but loving kindness shall surround him who trusts in Yahweh.
For we are consumed in your anger. We are troubled in your wrath.
then the lord of that servant will come in a day when he isn’t expecting him, and in an hour that he doesn’t know, and…
but to those who are self-seeking, and don’t obey the truth, but obey unrighteousness, will be wrath, indignation,
oppression, and anguish on every soul of man who does evil, to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.

translations.web: “How often is it that the lamp of the wicked is put out, that their calamity comes on them, that God distributes sorrows in his anger?
translations.bsb: How often is the lamp of the wicked put out? Does disaster come upon them? Does God, in His anger, apportion destruction?
translations.kjv: How oft is the candle of the wicked put out! and how oft cometh their destruction upon them! God distributeth sorrows in his anger.
translations.asv: How oft is it that the lamp of the wicked is put out? That their calamity cometh upon them? That God distributeth sorrows in his anger?
